'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Normal]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Projectiles. When the default spell is cast, it fires a single project towards the target. After 50 casts, the next cast fires multiple big arrows, increasing with the level of the spell.

Note, you will typically only ever see this if you wear the Bing Set.

'''Description:''' Pulling arrows from the Bing's Bow, after a few shots, a bunch of arrows mysteriously fall out. So magical!
